items.markdown:
Hair growth supplements primarily work by `supplying essential vitamins and minerals that support follicle health` , though they are only effective if you have an underlying nutritional deficiency.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DPVacn53y30)

### Key Ingredients & What They Do

- **Biotin (Vitamin B7):** Supports keratin production, though true deficiencies are rare, and high doses can skew medical lab tests.[[1]](https://ishrs.org/patients/treatments-for-hair-loss/nutrition-and-vitamins/)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)[[3]](https://www.facebook.com/AADskin/videos/do-biotin-supplements-really-help-with-hair-loss-heres-what-board-certified-derm/1057516907235066/)
- **Iron:** Carries oxygen to red blood cells and hair follicles; deficiency is a leading cause of shedding, especially in women.[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)[[3]](https://ishrs.org/patients/treatments-for-hair-loss/nutrition-and-vitamins/)
- **Zinc & Vitamin D:** Help reduce scalp inflammation, support follicle cycling, and repair tissue.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/the-best-vitamins-supplements-and-products-for-healthier-hair)
- **Marine Protein & Collagen (e.g., AminoMar):** Found in targeted blends like [Viviscal Hair Growth Supplements](https://www.viviscal.com/products/womans-hair-growth-supplements) to nourish thinning hair.[[1]](https://www.viviscal.com/products/womans-hair-growth-supplements)[[2]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)
- **Botanicals (e.g., Saw Palmetto):** Used in multi-pathway formulas like Nutrafol to help block DHT, a hormone linked to pattern hair loss.[[1]](https://www.ulta.com/discover/beauty-education/best-vitamins-for-hair-growth)

### Do They Actually Work?

- **FDA Regulation:** Supplements are not evaluated or approved by the FDA for treating hair loss.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/video/well/100000009840449/do-hair-growth-supplements-work.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DPVacn53y30)
- **Evidence vs. Meds:** Topical [minoxidil](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/) (Rogaine) and prescription finasteride have much stronger clinical backing for regrowing hair than over-the-counter vitamins.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DPVacn53y30)
- **Consult a Doctor:** Blood tests can confirm if you actually lack iron, vitamin D, or zinc before you spend money on costly blends.[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/do-hair-growth-supplements-actually-work/)[[2]](https://www.nytimes.com/video/well/100000009840449/do-hair-growth-supplements-work.html)

If you'd like to narrow this down, let me know:

- What **type of hair loss or shedding** you are experiencing (all-over thinning, a receding hairline, or patchy spots)
- Whether you have **any known deficiencies** or dietary restrictions (like vegan or vegetarian)

I can help you figure out if a supplement or a dermatologist visit is your best next step.
